SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.cds,
       s.sname,
       sc.CharterNum,
       s.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank_writing
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rank_writing

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS full_street_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500

WITH lf AS (
    SELECT s.School AS name,
           s.DOCType AS doc,
           f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name, doc
FROM lf
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM lf)

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31'
   OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'

SELECT s.Phone

JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode

SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS first_name, s.AdmLName1 AS last_name
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           sat.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount_of_more_smes
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS Percentage_Increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage_Increase ASC LIMIT 1)

    FROM races

champs AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driverId
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    JOIN lastRace lr ON lr.year = r.year AND lr.maxRound = r.round

SELECT c.year,
       AVG(CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, 2) AS REAL) * 60
         + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 4) AS REAL)) AS avg_time_seconds

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
)

WITH single_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.atom_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM single_mols) AS avg_oxygen_per_single_bonded_molecule
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_mols)

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT a.element
